title: ChatPing
description: A simple paper plugin that adds discord style @ pings to minecraft chat.
body:
When someone types `@username` in chat, the plugin:
- highlights the name in gold
- plays a ding sound so they actually notice it
- flashes a quick message above their hotbar
- sends them a private copy of the message so it doesn't get lost in chat spam

**install:**
just drop the jar in your plugins folder and restart. requires paper 1.21.1+. completely server side, no client mods needed.
